scope: RTT USB CDC/MAVLink/FTP backpressure slice: make thread_info FTP-safe and remove MMCSD low-stack source of stack_ovrflw noise

product_changes.change: Copy RT-Thread thread snapshots inside critical section, then format ExpandingString output outside the critical section.
Set CONFIG_RT_MMCSD_STACK_SIZE=2048 for the SD/MMC detect thread.
Set RT_MMCSD_STACK_SIZE 2048 in the generated header template used by SCons.
Keep accepted prior CDC_RX_QUEUE_DEPTH 32 backpressure fix.

root_cause_evidence.before: MAVFTP @SYS/threads.txt could trigger CDC disconnect during thread_info, and thread_info formatted ExpandingString while holding rt_enter_critical().
root_cause_evidence.after: MAVFTP @SYS/threads.txt, @SYS/memory.txt, and @PARAM/param.pck read successfully after moving formatting outside the critical section.

root_cause_evidence.before: threads.txt showed mmcsd_detec stack 932/1024 used, only 92 bytes free, close to Scheduler::_check_stack_free() 64-byte stack_overflow threshold.
root_cause_evidence.after: threads.txt showed mmcsd_detec stack 932/2048 used, 1116 bytes free.

scons_build.notes: dev_mmcsd_core.o was rebuilt, so RT_MMCSD_STACK_SIZE reached the SDIO/MMCSD component.

message_window.result: W06-W10 stayed stable at about 26Hz total, with requested 5Hz target messages around 49-51 per 10s.

mavftp_comprehensive.result: 6/6 PASS with --require-sd, including /APM write/read/delete and post-FTP stability.
mavftp_comprehensive.host_side_note: tests/test_mavftp.py without pymavlink add_message monkeypatch hit a host-side TypeError before firmware interaction; see test_mavftp.rc=1 and test_mavftp.stderr.

post_param_regression.result: W02-W04 target messages held about 49-52 per 10s.

remaining_risk: This accepts only the current USB CDC/MAVFTP/MMCSD stack slice, not the full ChibiOS replacement goal.
Broader workspace cleanup still needs a separate audit of unrelated old results, disabled workflow files, .cursor/.agents content, and other dirty/untracked items.
IOMCU/RC/PWM/safety and full external sensor parity still require their own gates.
